# Requirements Quality Checklist: VPN-SKILLS Repository Governance

**Purpose**: Validate whether the VPN-SKILLS spec defines a complete and internally consistent governance, distribution, and lifecycle contract for remote reusable skills.
**Created**: 2026-08-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are repository-governance requirements complete enough to specify the minimum contents of constitution, ADR index, Speckit config, and workflows? [Completeness, Spec ?FR-001, Spec ?FR-010]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the skill metadata contract explicit about exact fields, formats, and versioning guarantees across the API/CLI and index/catalog? [Completeness, Spec ?FR-004, Spec ?FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are deprecation requirements complete enough to define grace period, notification channels, and supported-until semantics for downstream projects? [Completeness, Spec ?FR-005, Spec ?FR-007, Spec ?User Story 3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is ?without copying them locally? precise about whether cached or vendored copies are forbidden, temporary, or allowed under exception? [Ambiguity, Spec ?User Story 2, Spec ?Assumption 5]
- [ ] CHK005 Is ?single source of truth? defined in a way that still accommodates bootstrap manifests and local project declarations without contradiction? [Clarity, Spec ?FR-006, Spec ?FR-009, Spec ?Assumption 5]
- [ ] CHK006 Are CI/CD quality thresholds sufficiently explicit beyond broad terms like linting, security scans, and minimum 70% coverage? [Clarity, Spec ?FR-003, Spec ?SC-007]

## Consistency & Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK007 Are backward-compatibility expectations consistent between semver/tagging requirements and the scenarios where projects pinned to older versions continue to work? [Consistency, Spec ?FR-005, Spec ?AC-3]
- [ ] CHK008 Do the edge cases fully cover transitive dependency failure, platform incompatibility, and vulnerable pinned versions for downstream consumers? [Coverage, Spec ?Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the dashboard/discovery scope consistent with the v1 repository-governance scope, or does it introduce a separate product surface that needs explicit phasing? [Consistency, Spec ?User Story 4, Spec ?FR-004, Spec ?SC-008]

## Acceptance Criteria & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK010 Are adoption metrics such as ?50% of downstream projects within 6 months? backed by a measurable baseline and ownership model? [Measurability, Spec ?SC-008]
- [ ] CHK011 Is ?publicly accessible? in SC-001 consistent with the assumption that the repo may live in GitHub Enterprise or Azure DevOps? [Conflict, Spec ?SC-001, Spec ?Assumption 1]
- [ ] CHK012 Are assumptions about automatic metadata extraction documented as validated constraints or do they hide a major dependency on release discipline and tag quality? [Assumption, Spec ?Assumption 6]
